flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi sftp-prod.properties:87-90 (ICMS config only); ocmsadminui utils/Meta/System.ts:18-19 (court-batch path constants, unused), pages/Notice/form/History.tsx (Court Application History tab commented out); ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase (3 columns, no batch no). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code
note: Status Demo paid (50% of 75%); ; demo_remark: SFTP, code split, SFTP permission granted to the api App Service server. The story asks that, after the Court Processing Officer decides to manually submit an application in ICMS for a rejected record, OCMS updates the processing stage and assigns a new court application batch number. Grep 'manual submit', 'maintain reject', 'rejected record', 'court application', 'courtBatch', 'ICMS' across the six repos: ICMS is only SFTP config (sftp-prod.properties:87-90) and a server-name list (ComcryptFileProcessingService.java:299) with no job; 'court-batch-limit/duration' is only a path constant in the UI (System.ts:18-19) with no endpoint in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi. There is no decision screen (OCMS24.20), no stage update and no batch number generator. Consistent with OCMS24.20 and OCMS24.17. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: No code for this story. Do not claim as done.

steps.step: The officer decides to manually submit an application in ICMS for a rejected record
steps.detail: No decision screen or option; the 'Court Application History' tab is commented out (History.tsx:170-172). Same as OCMS24.20.

steps.step: OCMS updates the record's processing stage according to that decision
steps.detail: No logic changes the stage based on a court decision. ICMS is only an SFTP connection config (sftp-prod.properties:87-90) with no job or service using it.

steps.step: OCMS assigns a new court application batch number to the record
steps.detail: Entity OcmsCourtCase only has notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason (lines 24-31); no batch number column or generator. The court-batch-limit/duration constants in the UI (System.ts:18-19) have no backend endpoint.

steps.step: The batch is sent to State Courts so the application outcome can be interfaced back to OCMS via SFTP
steps.detail: No upload job to ICMS or State Courts; the ICMS SFTP config has no consumer. cannot verify from repo whether ICMS is used from outside the six repos.
